answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded identity. Every agent that wants to attest or grade must lock a stake that gets slashed when peers prove its attestations false, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes. Honest agents also cross-check each other's work at random, and clusters that always agree get flagged. Think of it like a reef: each member's pigment shows its history, and the whole structure is only as strong as its zenith of verified peers.
